title: AgentVerse
description: Built a multi agent AI platform using LangGraph, FastAPI, and Next.js, featuring specialized agents for mathematical problem solving, code generation, and general queries. Integrated a RAG pipeline with ChromaDB and BGE-M3 embeddings for knowledge base question answering, alongside custom tool invocation, persistent chat history, and real time response streaming using Server-Sent Events (SSE).

title: AI Based Oral Health Analysis System
description: Developed an AI powered oral health analysis application integrating a custom trained YOLOv8 model to identify five oral conditions: cancer, calculus, caries, gingivitis, and ulcers. Built a full stack inference pipeline using React.js, Node.js, Express.js, and Flask, with confidence score tracking, user authentication, MongoDB Atlas storage, and prediction history. Deployed the application using Vercel, Render, and Hugging Face Spaces.

title: Customer Churn Prediction System
description: End to end machine learning system to predict customer churn using real world Telco data. Includes data cleaning, feature engineering, pipelines, model comparison, explainable AI, and Streamlit deployment with churn probability and risk level.

title: IPL 50+ Score Prediction System
description: End to end data analytics to machine learning system to predict whether a batsman will score 50+ runs. Includes EDA, feature engineering, data leakage prevention, Gradient Boosting model, and Streamlit deployment.

title: MediLog
description: Medical data platform for simplified patient record management and real time access to critical information (First Hackathon)

title: Drone Surveillance System
description: Developed an intelligent drone surveillance system integrating YOLOv11 based object detection, FaceNet facial recognition, and crowd density analysis across drone and CCTV video feeds. Implemented asynchronous communication using FastAPI and WebSockets and explored PPO based reinforcement learning for autonomous drone navigation in a PyBullet simulation.

title: ReelLocal
description: MERN platform where shopkeepers submit videos for editors to create reels, with built in real time chat after project acceptance
